tha-ap120:1.1: Maggasaññaka.] Padumuttarabuddhassa sāvakā vanacāriṇo / vippanaṭṭhā brahāraññe andhā va anusuyyare. // //
tha-ap120:2.1: Anussaritvā sambuddhaṃ Padumuttaranāyakaṃ / tassa te munino puttā vippanaṭṭhā mahāvane. // //
tha-ap120:3.1: Bhavanā oruhitvāna agamaṃ bhikkhusantike / tesaṃ maggaṃ va ācikkhiṃ bhojanañ ca adās' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap120:4.1: Tena kammena dipadinda lokajeṭṭha narāsabha / jātiyā sattavasso 'haṃ arahattaṃ apāpuṇiṃ. // //
tha-ap120:5.1: Sacakkhu nāma nāmena dvādasa cakkavattino / sattaratanasampannā pañcakappasate ito. // //
tha-ap120:6.1: Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh' ime / chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan
tha-ap120:7.1: ti. // // Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Maggasaññako thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthāti.
